---- MODULE EdgeGate ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT Buggy
VARIABLES granted, decision
Init == granted = 0 /\ decision = 0
Grant == granted <= 0 /\ granted' = 1 /\ decision' = (IF 1 + Buggy > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0)
Revoke == granted > 0 /\ granted' = 0 /\ decision' = (IF 0 + Buggy > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0)
Next == Grant \/ Revoke
FailClosed == decision <= granted
====
